accepted_behavior: Public unsafe attach_owned_with_text_clipboard validates both policies before handles and uses the same real owner/pool/Job/queue/worker; unsupported display is None, invalid handle Unavailable and duplicate admission Busy. Default DnD mode remains text-disabled.

Public reserve_text_paste takes the immutable real endpoint control and SID; foreign endpoints fail before Busy. TextPasteRequest is private metadata plus lightweight Ping, without Clone/Copy/Default/serde/native owner/body/callback/public ID; Debug is constant and redacted.

Public ACK, poll, cancel and Drop signal the real worker after all inner guards have been destroyed. No join or synchronous native Receive is performed by these wrappers. RAW UTF8 including CRLF and empty EOF are delivered once.

Cancel and Drop of reserved or real reading requests release only after actual worker retirement; source A remains open through successor B, and old request operations cannot cancel or steal B. A live request does not retain the native window/display beyond certified close.

Native Copy Enter/Drop is rejected while Text is Reserved or Reading, preserving the exact Incoming and actual Generic/FD/payload. A genuine Copy works afterward. Conversely real DnD Hover, Reading, AwaitingDecision and undrained terminal exclude Text until the exact terminal ACK.

A nondefault cap7 reaches the actual reader: empty EOF, exact7 UTF8+CRLF, invalid UTF8, valid8 rejected TooLarge without EOF, and real1s read timeout with drained prefix/source open. First error survives later cancel; actual FD is gone before slot release and a fresh same-Selection transfer.

Keyboard loss without Leave clears focus and destroys the old Selection, cancels the real open reader, releases old keyboard and requires a new Selection/new focus generation for recovery. Two real keyboard incarnations are released at normal close.

Reserve freezes Plain MIME; an adversarial late UTF8 event on the same offer does not change the admitted request, while the next request prefers UTF8. Replacing Selection cuts Reading without EOF; NULL cuts Reserved without issuing Receive; new Selection works and old handles remain inert.

An actual published but entirely unpolled result keeps Incoming occupied and rejects native Copy while unexpired. The worker expires its body and admits B without poll/cancel A or Selection re-emission; late A yields Timeout once and cannot affect the actual B reader/body.
